games.title: The long winter
games.tone: Cold, political, slowly flooding. Everyone is negotiating with someone.

scopes.name: Keep the eastern district above water until the thaw
scopes.mission: Three factions, one failing pump station, and a council that will not meet.
scopes.startingPoint: The pump stalls at dawn and nobody who can fix it will answer the door.

world: The old aqueduct under the market
A winter that will not break
problems: Guild enforcers on the eastern span
findings: A key to the aqueduct grate
questions: Can the pump be saved at all?
